newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wool indicator rises 5 cents to 719c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australian wool indicator rises 5 cents to 719c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose another five cents to 719 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Most merino fleece gained with 19/24/26 microns one percent dearer, 21/22/23/25m 0.5 percent dearer and 20m slightly cheaper.
Merino skirtings were one percent dearer.
Crossbreds also gained with 27m slightly dearer, 28m 0.5 percent dearer, 29/30m up to one percent dearer and 31m up to two percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were unchanged, locks one percent dearer and crutchings 1.5 percent dearer.
WI said Japanese interests including China were the principal buyers with good support from Western Europe.
Of the 24,882 bales offered, 6.0 percent were passed in.
Sales continue Thursday in Sydney and Melbourne with about 25,400 bales to be offered.
